336:t_014:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's nice to see young people with drive.」

336:t_014:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! I'll fight for world peace and money!」

336:t_015:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「I confirm all enemies have been eliminated.」

336:t_015:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, withdraw immediately! We're leaving this area before $$ストラウス$$ arrives!」

336:t_015:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...It seems we were a little too late.」

336:t_016:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Damn! I failed to wipe out the enemy before the Supreme Commander arrived...!」

336:t_017:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, withdraw immediately! We're leaving this area before $$ストラウス$$ arrives!」

336:t_017:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...It seems we were a little too late.」

336:t_018:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I feel it...! Is it a $$スフィア・リアクター$$!?」

336:t_018:1.en:
$n
「It isn't just the $$欲深な金牛$$! Aboard that ship...!」

336:t_018:3.en:
$n
「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$...! Is he aboard too!?」

336:t_018:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Is that man... looking at me...?」

336:t_018:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...The $$揺れる天秤$$... Perhaps he was not worth my interest after all.」

336:t_019:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$! Have you come out in person just to dispose of us!?」

336:t_019:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He wants two $$リアクター$$s and a $$特異点$$...! Is that what he's after!?」

336:t_020:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, get away! If this continues, a $$時空震動$$ will occur!?」

336:t_020:5.en:
$$桂$$
「This... isn't like the $$時空震動$$s we've seen before!」

336:t_020:7.en:
$n
「This feeling... It's just like that time in $$第２新東京市$$...!」

336:t_023:1.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...I do not know either...」

336:t_023:2.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「What in the world is happening...?」

336:t_024:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ahaha... I suppose I can't criticize $$ギルター$$ now.」

336:t_024:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ah... But, everyone, aside from me, the $$サイデリアル$$ forces really are an elite unit. Please bear that in mind.」

336:t_025:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It sounds like you've got some history with him too.」

336:t_025:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. ...Do you want to hear about my adventures on $$翠の地球$$?」

336:t_025:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, $$デュオ$$. I don't have any room to spare in my heart or my wallet right now.」

336:t_025:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's always true, not just right now.」

336:t_025:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Let's pull ourselves together and go! Life has its ups and downs!」

336:t_025:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Your lows are way too low, as always.」

336:t_026:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I was careless...! To think I cannot stand on the same battlefield as the Supreme Commander!」

336:t_026:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But now I have something new to enjoy! Fighting you as you grow stronger makes me the happiest man in the galaxy!」

336:t_027:1.en:
$$桂$$
「He's the type who thinks with his muscles... Personally, I don't dislike that.」

336:t_028:0.en:
$$桂$$
「You've got good teamwork. It seems you've been through quite a few deadly situations.」

336:t_028:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That isn't exactly something to be happy about.」

336:t_028:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「But from now on, our small force must fight the Empire's vast military strength.」

336:t_028:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「When neither strategy nor tactics can overcome our disadvantage, only each person's fighting spirit can change it...!」

336:t_028:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「We'll join those spirits together and fight...!」

336:t_100:0.en:
$$カレン$$
($$エスター$$... I had a feeling, but something did happen to you...)

336:t_100:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(But I believe in you... Even after becoming a $$次元獣$$, you became human again...!)

336:t_100:2.en:
$$カレン$$
(I believe we'll meet again this time too...! So I'll do my best too!)

336:t_101:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I've been looking for you, Mr. $$特異点$$. The $$新地球皇国$$ would like to welcome you.」

336:t_101:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know why you want me, but I'll be damned if I help an invader.」

336:t_101:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Would you refuse even with a hundred beautiful women thrown in?」

336:t_101:3.en:
$$桂$$
「I see... You seem to have looked into me a little, but not enough, huh?」

336:t_101:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then would a thousand do? Would ten thousand do?」

336:t_101:5.en:
$$桂$$
「There's only one girl I want in this whole multiverse! I won't help anyone who doesn't understand that!」

336:t_102:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Yes, yes, $$桂木桂$$! As a warrior, you give me even more enjoyment than you do as a $$特異点$$!」

336:t_102:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, but I don't get my kicks from making men happy...! I'd like you to leave the stage now!」

336:t_102:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You talk like a frivolous fool, but those warrior's eyes shrewdly target the bridge...! You truly are first-rate!」

336:t_102:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Your advances are awfully annoying! I'll just have to shut you up now!」

336:t_103:0.en:
$$桂$$
(It seems there's no $$エマーン$$ on $$翠の地球$$ either...)

336:t_103:1.en:
$$桂$$
(But I won't give up... If $$ミムジィ$$ is in some world, I'll survive until I reach it...!)

336:t_103:2.en:
$$桂$$
(Where am I going, and when can I return...? I don't know the answer, but I will return to $$ミムジィ$$!)

336:t_104:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well~ I didn't really notice when we fought together, but you're quite the miser, $$クロウ$$.」

336:t_104:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's better than you, hiding your true nature to sneak in among us.」

336:t_104:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Is it? I'm always like this, but you're earning yourself negative marks, $$クロウ$$.」

336:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If $$クラヴィア$$ heard this, she'd be disillusioned.」

336:t_104:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't you shamelessly bring up $$クラヴィア$$'s name.」

336:t_104:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...That murderous aura... It seems I've made you serious.」
